## 1. Verdict: NOT YET

Freeze once these are written in; all are wording, and none needs a new scratch run.

- **BD2 1.3, false premise** (IMPLIED births receive nothing). Write: "fixed at birth for a birth that received a fresh distinction; the engine checks each birth after round s, and a run with one that received none is tested in full. P1 control runs are tested in full."
- **BD2 1.3, the cap of 8.** Add: "Pairs are ordered by s, then by the birth order of X's, then Y's, earliest member. A differing pair whose barred run was not knot-tested is 'undecided: knot test not run', never 'found'."
- **BD2 6.3, attribution.** Add: "Accepted when the differing part holds at least one knot from Y only, whatever else it holds; a part holding only knots from neither or from both is not."
- **BD2 6.3, the ∅ run.** Add: "Whether the A = ∅ run has a meeting is reported. Where it has none, the result is worded 'meets against does not meet'."
- **Attribution is the condition but was never run.**
  - B4's dependence candidate becomes "(a) for the difference, (c) for attribution".
  - Add an outcome: "**Differs, not attributed.** The course changes with Y barred, but the first differing value holds no knot from Y only; no dependence through the meeting is claimed."
  - The Expected sentence and owner sentence 3 are used only when attribution passes and m = 1.
- **BD2 7.3 (N2).**
  - Write "each pair is run with A = Y and A = ∅ only"; as drafted, 6.3 cannot be decided there.
  - Fix the laws before the run: "the B4 candidates, the two fixed laws, and any other law minimal after 1a; laws of 1b and 1c are not renamed".
- **BD2 4.1.** "The ring without its rotation symmetry" becomes "…; the reflection through knot 0 remains, so X and Y may still be exchanged (BD2 6.8)".
- **Cuts.** Add: "If 1b or 1c is cut, 'least among the listed laws' reads 'least among the laws run'."
- **BD2 6.8.** Give the exact symmetry search a node count, with "undecided" beyond it.

## 2. The four questions

- **(1) Yes, register Whether.** It is the presence reading, the same kind as ticket A's, and the results must say so. On the seen case it is "the parts meet, against they do not".
- **(2) Mark it (a), a replication.** Write: "the start was chosen before the scratch run; the prediction was not." It is no longer a blind catch, and the reflection weakens it further. Optional: add a ring with knot 0 holding four and knot 1 holding five, unpredicted and unrun.
- **(3) Enough**, provided results say "verdicts and courses equal exactly; whole structures not distinguished by an invariant", never "identical". Risk: with the ∅ runs, a ring item is nearer the 15 s of barred items than 3 s, so N2 may take about 15 minutes. That is still inside the cap.
- **(4) Acceptable** with the two BD2 1.3 lines above.

## 3. Sentences that say more than the runs can

- **"Under the recorded rations with a take of a sole candidate"** → "Under FLOOR1 and CAP-3 with short knots waiting, and a take of a sole candidate (a rule added by hand)". ORD and the other treatments gave no strict link.
- **"Under PARENT-OWING, one rule added by hand, it changes"** → "Under a different treatment (short knots make offshoots), no such link forms unless a second rule is added by hand, PARENT-OWING; with it the parts link and the course changes". OFFSHOOT-TWO gave no strict pair, so the added rule makes the link as well as the difference.
- **Owner sentence 2, "an offshoot receiving as many fresh distinctions as…"** → "an offshoot receiving at least two, and otherwise as many…".
- **Owner sentence 3, "handed a count over through a made knot"** → "handed a count over at a meeting that a made knot links".
- **"Settled by construction"** → "Settled by argument (not refereed)".
- **B1-link, "on the class M starts"** → "on all 8 starts under FLOOR1, and on the four ring starts under CAP-3".

## 4. Advice rejected wrongly

- None. Whether, the invariant, 10 renamings and omitting Q-SOLE are all defensible.
- One item was mis-applied: B4 is marked (a) for a verdict whose condition was never run (fixed in 1).

## 5. For the owner

"If confirmed: two alike pieces that the growth itself built come into contact through a knot that the growth also built and that both descend from. No knot we supplied at the start connects them, and the rule responsible uses no names. Two rules were added by hand to get this: a newborn takes an outside distinction only when exactly one is on offer, and an offshoot receives as many fresh distinctions as its parent was asked to join in, at least two. Then the first piece grows differently when the second is switched off. But what passes is one number at one birth. It says only whether the second piece's two members joined, which is also whether the pieces meet at all. It does not show a pattern responding to which pattern it meets, anything built up over several births, or a fold of emergence. It was checked on eight small starts, seven rounds, a listed set of rules and a few dozen renumberings."
